featured_reviews.name: Shreya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the best experience with The Lightsmiths capturing our wedding pictures and videos. Vibhuti and the team were an absolute pleasure to work with. They beautifully captured the intimate moments between my husband and me, making us feel incredibly comfortable throughout the entire process.

The photographs were stunning, and the video was exceptional, featuring a perfect blend of traditional music for our South Indian wedding and modern tunes for the reception. Our family and loved ones adore the video, and it has quickly become a cherished keepsake. We are so grateful for their talent and professionalism.

Highly recommend The Lightsmiths for anyone looking to preserve their special moments!

featured_reviews.name: Natasha Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Planning a wedding is stressful, but working with Vibhuti and Rahul is the opposite. From the moment we met them (and I locked them down at the very beginning!) they became my favourite people throughout the entire process.

They and their team are some of the kindest souls you’ll come across, and their talent truly speaks for itself. The photos and videos they captured went far beyond anything I had imagined. More than that, they made everyone, including my camera-shy husband, feel completely at ease. We actually had fun being photographed for our portraits! By the end of the wedding, it really felt like they were part of the family.

They documented our celebrations in the most dreamy and beautiful way. I can still feel all the joy, emotion, and celebration when I look back at it all. Every photo feels like it holds a memory, not just a moment. Our friends and family have also been loving the pictures and videos, and I couldn’t be more grateful.

Amid all the wedding chaos, they were a calming presence, especially Vibhuti. She helped me pause, breathe, and take it all in — something I’ll always be thankful for.

It honestly felt like two of our close friends were capturing our wedding. And even now, we’re still connected. I’d recommend them in a heartbeat. They’re truly something special.

featured_reviews.name: Vaidehi Dhoot
featured_reviews.review_text:
We couldn’t be more thrilled with the incredible work Vibhuti & Rahul at The Lightsmiths did for our wedding! From the moment we met, they made us feel comfortable and listened to every detail of what we envisioned for our big day. Their professionalism and creativity shone through every shot, capturing all the love, laughter, and unforgettable moments in the most beautiful and artistic way.

The final video was beyond our expectations—it felt like reliving our wedding day all over again. Every time we watch it (even now 10 years post our wedding) we’re transported back to the emotions and joy of that special day. They didn’t just capture the event; they told our story perfectly, with all the little touches that made the day unique to us.

Thank you so much for your amazing talent, patience, and dedication. We will cherish this video for a lifetime!

featured_reviews.name: Saniya Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with The Lightsmiths for my wedding photography & videos was an amazing experience! They took the time to understand our taste & needs for the style of photographs beforehand & were very flexible & understanding in the lead up to the wedding.

Through the wedding days, they managed to capture all the best moments and were present without being intrusive and also providing lots of advice along the way.

The end products with the photos and videos has been mind blowing!! The final video that they have shared has captured all the right moments and feelings, while really being an extremely well edited video. Our friends and family still give us loads of compliments on it

Highly recommend working with The Lightsmiths to capture your special days in the best way!

featured_reviews.name: gargi panwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had already seen their work when they had filmed and photographed our friends wedding and we were just blown away by their art!!! Their photography is like an art because it  immerses you in the world created through their lens!!!
We had such a great experience with them!! It’s been 9 years since I’m married and when I still see my wedding film I feel awed because it’s too precious and beautifully made! Thank you guys… love you 💗

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil John
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of having The Lightsmiths cover my wedding last February, and I can confidently say they exceeded all expectations. From the very beginning, their professionalism and passion for their craft were evident. They have a remarkable ability to blend into the background, capturing the most candid and genuine moments without ever feeling intrusive.

The quality of their photography is nothing short of superb. They masterfully balanced candid shots with technical precision, ensuring that every photo was not only a beautiful memory but also a work of art. The attention to detail in each frame, the play of light and shadows, and the natural expressions they captured were truly remarkable.What stood out the most was their commitment to making us feel comfortable and relaxed throughout the day. Their friendly and approachable nature made it easy to forget the camera was even there, allowing for the most authentic moments to be captured.

They were also incredibly flexible and accommodating to our requests, which made the entire experience seamless and stress-free.

The final photos were delivered promptly, and the quality was exceptional. Each image told a story, beautifully encapsulating the emotions and joy of our special day. We have received countless compliments on our wedding photos, and we owe it all to The Lightsmiths.

featured_reviews.name: Panchami Ghavri
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Lightsmiths did the videography for our wedding in Sri Lanka. We had the best experience working with them. They have become an integral part of our story almost like family to me and vish and our families. Both Rahul and Vibhuti got the brief pretty much from the time we met, they cut the most wonderful footage for our wedding video!
We highly recommend! Complete no brainer :)
Thank you to both of you for the momories!

Panch & Vish

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Rubina Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across The Lightsmiths when I happened to see one of their videos online & I exclaimed “That’s how a Wedding is Shot!!!"

From the first time I called them, I felt an instant connection with Vibhuti. She was patient, listened to exactly what I wanted & I was instantly at peace because I knew, I have made the right choice & boy!! Did they deliver!!

They were punctual, (actually, earlier than the time that I needed them to be there ), happy and so so comfortable to work with. They were not people who were filming our wedding. They became a part of our family who also happened to film our wedding! They blended so well. They checked up on me, my husband, my family and went over and beyond with what I expected from them.

When we received our videos we could not have been happier. From the short film, to the long film, the videos were captured so so so so beautifully .. when you’re busy being the bride and groom it all goes by in a flash and there are so many bits you miss, so watching the film, interviews and seeing some of the behind the scenes was absolutely fantastic. We will forever treasure our videos, they made us laugh and cry happy tears and bring out so many emotions. I can’t thank them enough !!

If you are considering getting your wedding filmed – absolutely do so! They will NOT let you down !

featured_reviews.name: Chirayu Mahadeshwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I found Kashish Foto Vision on Instagram through fellow photographers and decided to visit for a lens and camera body cleaning service. My lenses had fungal growth and needed a proper cleanup. However, what I experienced at this store was beyond disappointing—it was outright unprofessional and shady.

After discussing the charges, the owner took my gear but refused to provide any receipt or proof of deposit. When I questioned this, he casually said, “We don’t give receipts.” Who in their right mind would leave expensive camera equipment with a store that doesn’t even provide basic proof of deposit? That was a huge red flag.

Sensing something off, I immediately asked for my gear back. Instead of handling the situation professionally, the owner rudely told his staff not to entertain me as a customer again and even went as far as saying that if I ever came to buy a camera, I shouldn’t be considered as a customer. This was not just embarrassing—it was an absolute disgrace.

This kind of attitude is unacceptable. A business that lacks professionalism, transparency, and basic customer respect doesn’t deserve anyone’s time or money. If you value your gear and want to be treated with even a shred of decency, I highly recommend taking your business elsewhere.

featured_reviews.name: satej bagade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi friends,
I am sharing my worst experience of purchasing my camera kit with Macro photo(Mahendra Jain) , bora bazaar street, Mumbai .
I went to buy a new Nikon D500 DSLR camera body and a new Nikkor 200-500mm 5.6 VR lens from him on 06-03-2017 .Firstly regarding the body, he sold me at a INR price of 1.15k in cash, but without bill saying that he will just write the date behind the Warranty card and take care of it whenever i want to sell it or have any complaint and need to give it to Nikon Service centre.I agreed as i had purchased equipment from him few years ago and i trusted in him.
Secondly, regarding the Nikkor 200-500mm 5.6 VR lens, i wanted to buy it with bill but he tempted me to buy a lens from GREY Market and said that with bill stocks where short in the market then. I got tempted to buy it for a little small amount and got cheated as Nikkor 200-500mm 5.6 VR lens was never ever available from Grey market.What had happened was he had got a second hand lens (with box and printed price) lying in his shop for resale which he sold to me as a new one from Grey market.
Later on this year in January 2018,i needed to upgrade my equipment and sell off the used one i bought from him just 8-9 months back. For the same reason i contacted Mr Mahendra Jain, owner of Macro photo and asked him to prepare a bill for the Nikon D500 body i bought from him in March 2017 so that i can sell it on Olx or similar buy/sell platforms. He surprisingly refused for the bill and ignored my request. Giving silly reasons that the bill can't be given so late after sales and also the GST is applicable now, he simply ignored me.
I was shocked with his statements as i believed in his words at the time of purchasing the equipment and got embarrassed with the feeling that i have got cheated.
Also it became very difficult for me to sell the lens as i got cheated regarding it too as it never comes from grey market and i learnt the thing while selling it on buy/sell platforms from buyers and lateron confirmed it from my another camera dealer friend that the specific lens was never ever available from grey market.
So friends, If you want to buy any photography related equipment in future, never go to this cheater person ever.He fearlessly sells the camera equipment without bill and cheats genuine buyers openly.

I was looking to get a professional family photograph with my parents, and on a friend’s recommendation, I booked an appointment with Mr. Rajesh Chaddha at Indian Art Studio.

From the very first interaction, the experience was extremely professional. I truly appreciated how he took the time to clearly explain the entire process, making us feel at ease and well-informed.

The moment we entered the studio, we were in awe of the space. In fact, my father was so impressed that he wanted to photograph the studio itself :-)! The warmth and comfort that Mr. Rajesh Chaddha created for us is hard to put into words. It reflects not only his personal expertise but also the rich legacy of his family—being the fourth generation running this remarkable studio.

What started as a plan for one or two photographs turned into an extensive and memorable photoshoot. We ended up capturing many beautiful moments that we will cherish for years to come.

It’s incredible to experience a studio with over 100 years of history, still delivering such excellence and personal touch. Highly recommended for anyone looking for timeless, high-quality photography.

featured_reviews.name: PRATEEP BHADURI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today, while carrying flowers back to my room, I happened to stop at Indian Art Studio, Kalbadevi, Mumbai. Earlier, one of the gentlemen at the Studio had invited me to visit, after noticing my curiosity towards the photographs displayed there. True to my word, I returned before catching the Metro and spent some time inside this remarkable establishment.
What I discovered was not merely a photography studio, but a living repository of memories, heritage and history. I had the privilege of meeting Shri. Sanjay Chaddha, one of the fourth-generation owners of this iconic studio. The very fact that the Studio continues to be run by the fourth generation speaks volumes about its legacy and commitment to preserving the art of photography.
The old black-and-white photographs, the carefully preserved colour portraits, and the timeless architecture of the Studio create an atmosphere that is difficult to describe in words. Every photograph appears to tell a story. Every frame seems to carry the memories, emotions and lives of people from another era. One cannot help but pause and reflect upon the passage of time.
What impressed me most was that Indian Art Studio has managed to preserve not only photographs but also a sense of nostalgia. The moment one steps inside, one is transported to a different period of Mumbai's history. In today's fast-changing world, such places are becoming increasingly rare.
For me, Indian Art Studio is not merely a business establishment. It is a temple of memories, heritage and human stories. Its architecture is as captivating as the photographs it houses, and together they create an experience that every lover of history, art, photography and old Mumbai should witness at least once.
I extend my heartfelt best wishes to Shri. Sanjay Chadda and the entire Chadda family for preserving this wonderful legacy. May Indian Art Studio continue to inspire future generations and remind us that photographs are not merely images—they are fragments of time preserved forever.
----Advocate Prateep Bhaduri.
